spec.name: ai-use-case-to-release
spec.description: The ADLC spine for one AI use case: qualify → govern → data → model → prompt → evaluate → red-team → guardrails → cost → (AI risk lead approves) → release plan built from the real results.

inputs.name: data
inputs.from: a sample of the data the system will use

inputs.name: pii_policy
inputs.from: pii_type,handling; without it handling is TBD with the Privacy officer

inputs.name: candidates
inputs.from: candidate models with your own benchmark scores and prices

inputs.name: model_workload
inputs.from: tokens per request and volume, for monthly cost per candidate

inputs.name: prompt_spec
inputs.from: prompt spec (role, task, variables, output schema, examples)

inputs.name: eval_cases
inputs.from: golden eval cases with outputs to score

inputs.name: app_profile
inputs.from: red-team profile: purpose, tools, data, canary

inputs.name: attack_responses
inputs.from: the app's responses to the generated attacks

inputs.name: guardrail_policy
inputs.from: blocked topics, PII handling, limits, tool allowlist

inputs.name: release_facts
inputs.from: facts the earlier steps cannot measure: risk tier, latency, traffic, rollback time, owners

approval.note: Review governance register, PII inventory, red-team scorecard and guardrails before a release plan is drawn up.

notes.content:
# Northwind Retail — discovery call 2026-09-02

- Maria Chen (CTO): Pickup orders dropped during peak and we ran a war room for nine days.
- Maria Chen (CTO): The peak post-mortem puts the incident cost at $1.4M in lost orders and overtime.
- Raj Patel (VP Supply Chain): Split shipments run at 6.2% and each point costs us margin.
- Raj Patel (VP Supply Chain): Adding a marketplace takes 14 weeks because one engineer owns the OMS integrations.
- DECISION: Maria Chen (CTO) signs off; the CFO co-approves anything over $1M.
- BUDGET: Capex is approved for platform work in FY27; opex for run improvement is not yet funded.
- Maria Chen (CTO): Peak freeze starts 2026-11-10; nothing cuts over inside the freeze.
- We discussed their office move.
